quest.title: A Company Vanishing Into the Deep
quest.description: You encounter a group of Fatui who have lost contact with their troops on the ground. But they don't seem combat able at all and even ask for your help...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x300, Primogem x40, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Ready for combat) Fine then, I can help you surrender.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me your purpose first.

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: Well, I'll say this: whatever doubts you may have, the only purpose we have here is to investigate the source of the calamity in The Chasm.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What calamity? Paimon's seen no sign of it in The Chasm.

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: The calamity that happened five hundred years ago is only the beginning. The war against the dark has never stopped, and one of its battlefields is right beneath our feet.

dialogues.speaker: Danila
dialogues.text: *sigh* Our Serzhant CO is so hungry that he's started to talk some crazy stuff...

dialogues.speaker: Temur
dialogues.text: He always likes to exaggerate, but this is the first time he's talked nonsense.

dialogues.speaker: Radomir
dialogues.text: Forget it. What Antoha means is, well, that the people of Liyue are no enemy to us.

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: At least not in this operation, not to us here in the Ninth Company ... But I'm not so sure how our comrades who went missing might perceive the matter.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll help you on account of humanity, but just this once.

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: Th—Thank you! We'll forever be grateful.

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: *sigh* I'm sorry, but there's a... small issue... with our chain of command.

dialogues.speaker: Danila
dialogues.text: "A small issue"!? We just betrayed our men by standing here as we watched someone else chase them off!

dialogues.speaker: Temur
dialogues.text: Then what do you suggest we did? Let them beat us up and have our food snatched away? Zip that mouth of yours shut and focus on eating.

dialogues.speaker: Radomir
dialogues.text: Antoha, stop downplaying this. Our chain of command has been wiped out. It's gone! Our captains and other higher-ranking COs have either gone missing or got killed... That leaves us no other choice but to retreat.

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: But many of our men refuse to do so... They'd rather hold on to what's left behind by our COs and fight till the last man standing.

dialogues.speaker: Danila
dialogues.text: I'd say it's "starve" till the last man standing... According to the collaboration agreement, people up there are supposed to relay orders and supply us with food, but we haven't heard from them for a long time.

dialogues.speaker: Temur
dialogues.text: We're loyal to the Fatui and Lord Harbingers — as we should be — but we're no fools. Anyone sensible would have long suggested that we retreat under such circumstances.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, what's your plan?

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: Mmm... I know that this isn't your concern, and I won't stop you if you wanna leave, but we're really out of our depth and could use your help.

choices.text: I need to think about it.

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: OK. Stay safe. But be careful. Our other comrades scattered around here might not be as friendly.

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: I'm not supposed to tell you this, but... there's a supply station near the ground level. All our supplies go through there, and we sometimes got orders there, too.

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: We sent a few men up for food, but they haven't returned... I can't afford to risk another trip.

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: No one has come down from the supply station for a long time, either. I hope you can check the situation there for me.

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: I'm so sorry to trouble you, but we need to know what's happening on the ground... Otherwise, any decisions we might make would be too rash.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, okay, you're starting to confuse Paimon with all the convoluted talking! We'll look out for it when we pass by.

choices.text: What do you need me to do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here is the food you wanted.

talks.objective: Go to the supply station to look for clues

dialogues.speaker: Lost Document
dialogues.text: "...Emergency Announcement from the Secretary at Yujing Terrace: The malignant and destructive incident recently occurring at the Jade Chamber has proved that the Fatui are dangerous and untrustworthy..."

dialogues.speaker: Lost Document
dialogues.text: "...The collaboration agreement with Snezhnaya has been nullified. The Liyue Qixing will take over the exploration of The Chasm..."

dialogues.speaker: Lost Document
dialogues.text: "...The Millelith shall not make contact with any member of the Fatui. Violation of this rule will result in immediate arrest without clemency!"

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: Whatever the case, thank you for giving us food.

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: We'll find a way to get out of here.

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: You're back. How is it? Any news from the station?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: It has been abandoned.

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: Is that so... Then, did you find anything?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You're no longer welcome in Liyue Harbor, I fear.

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: Other than this, do you have any other news?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Here's a letter we found. Seems it's for you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Here you are...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The Fatui soldiers read the letter...

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: Ah, it's from Yanbo. I got it.

dialogues.speaker: Radomir
dialogues.text: What happened? The Millelith are gone too? Let me read it...

dialogues.speaker: Danila
dialogues.text: *sigh* What's with them? We're fighting for them! Aren't we allies?

dialogues.speaker: Radomir
dialogues.text: There are no allies anymore. No more collaboration... To be precise, the Fatui are no longer in a collaborative relationship with Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Temur
dialogues.text: This is betrayal! The people of Liyue have betrayed us!

dialogues.speaker: Radomir
dialogues.text: Maybe it's the other way around in their eyes? Perhaps they think that we, the Fatui, have betrayed them...

dialogues.speaker: Danila
dialogues.text: This can't be! We came here to protect the people of Liyue! Don't you remember what the Kapitan said before our departure? "This expedition has nothing to do with conspiracies or schemes!"

dialogues.speaker: Temur
dialogues.text: But that couldn't prevent conspiracies and schemes from coming to us, could it? This isn't something we have control over, Danila.

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: OK, I see. *Deep breath*... I've decided — we need to retreat, the quicker the better.

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: It's alright. I'll take full responsibility. If there's any deserter amongst us... If any deserter shall bring dishonor to the Ninth Company, that's me and only me.

dialogues.speaker: Radomir
dialogues.text: ...Danila is right. We're here to protect the people of Liyue from the Calamity of the Darkness. We can't leave like this.

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: Do you think this is the right time to worry about your personal honor, Mirka? Can't you see it?

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: Can't you see that the people of Liyue neither need our protection, nor even want us here? They even defeated our comrades, who thought of themselves as heroes!

choices.text: Yes, you've betrayed the trust of the people of Liyue.

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: We should retreat, and preferably in silence. Without alerting the local Millelith.

response.speaker: Radomir
response.text: The Kapitan said that we should be ready to give our lives here. We should...

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: He also said that he wouldn't let anyone die in vain! That he didn't want the whole company to be buried here!

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: At least we're still alive. At least not all of the Ninth Company are gone. Do you understand?

response.speaker: Radomir
response.text: Yes, Sir!

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: OK, any more questions? I don't want to hear any objections. You're now dismissed.

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: #Whatever the case, {NICKNAME}, thank you for helping out. Take this Mora and these supplies.

choices.text: Best you consider what you're gonna do next.

talks.objective: Find Yanbo's Note and give it to the Fatui

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: *Huff* Sorry to stop you if you're in a hurry. I'm Serzhant Anton Melnikov, the... Acting CO of the Ninth Company. Just call me Anton.

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: They are Danila, Temur, Radomir and... uh, Romanski. He's not here. He's at the... medical camp.

dialogues.speaker: Danila
dialogues.text: Neither Romanski nor the medical camp remains, Antoha. Romanski didn't make it through the morning.

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: Danila, how many times have I told you. I'm in charge of the company now. Call me Serzhant Anton!

dialogues.speaker: Temur
dialogues.text: Ha! In charge of the company, as a Serzhant! Who do you think you are? Ever since the Kapitan went missing, you've been acting like an important-looking CO. Hah!

dialogues.speaker: Radomir
dialogues.text: That's enough, Temur... Your growling stomach must've messed with your judgment. Calm down and preserve your energy.

dialogues.speaker: Danila
dialogues.text: It's "Acting CO" Antoha.

dialogues.speaker: Temur
dialogues.text: Acting CO, my foot! Just for how long do we have to take orders from this fake CO who doesn't even know what he's doing?

dialogues.speaker: Radomir
dialogues.text: Hey, Temur, your brain must be intoxicated with hunger. I suggest you take a few punches to sober up.

dialogues.speaker: Temur
dialogues.text: Suits me! Go ahead! Come at me and I'll help you sober up too!

dialogues.speaker: Danila
dialogues.text: Great! After running out of rations, we're also saying goodbye to our sanity and patience. Splendid! Draining every last ounce of energy we have here, what an enlightened course of action...

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: Ahem...! Silence! If you're itching for a fight, then go down and fight the monsters that came from the black mud! And don't you forget to fight them with your growling stomach too!

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: If we wanna live and walk outta here alive, we must stick together! Don't make me repeat myself, OK?

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: Alright, give me a "If not us, then who?" on three. One, two, three!

dialogues.speaker: Danila
dialogues.text: If not us, then who.

dialogues.speaker: Radomir
dialogues.text: If not us, then who...

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: Uh, so, my friend, you must've noticed that... *cough* we're not very combat-effective at present. There's... been a small issue.

dialogues.speaker: Radomir
dialogues.text: Hmph, "a small issue!" You certainly talk like the Kapitan...

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: Since he's not here, I'm the acting commander! Now, why don't you shut that clever mouth of yours!

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: Sorry, my friend. We're in dire need of your help.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Since when have we become "friends"?

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: What do you want? Supplies, weapons, intel, or Mora — we've plenty of them. Take them all if you'd like, so long as you help us.

dialogues.speaker: Temur
dialogues.text: Ah, look, our beggar CO just took on the most humiliating job ever... losing the last ounce of dignity we're left with on our behalf.

dialogues.speaker: Danila
dialogues.text: Knock it off already! Are you expecting to fill your tummy with bitter sarcasm?

dialogues.speaker: Temur
dialogues.text: "Join our ranks! Let our marching boots shake the earth like thunder! You who will march with us towards the polestar of the white night, come! We shall never abandon you..."

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: Oh, someone shut him up already!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh... Although they're all bad guys, seeing them all famished certainly makes Paimon feel sorry for 'em...

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: It shames me to admit this... But as you can see, we're no longer combat-effective in the least. All we want is some food.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why would I want to help you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And then?

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: We'll leave and never return. I promise you... on the honor of the Ninth Company, on our ancestors who defended the land of Snezhnaya.

dialogues.speaker: Temur
dialogues.text: *sigh* Oh, you poor thing, how famished, how pathetic!

dialogues.speaker: Radomir
dialogues.text: Enough of that. You're no better anyway...

dialogues.speaker: Danila
dialogues.text: Anyway, there were 64 of us when we arrived, 64 in total! Now there are only four starving souls left. What other purposes would we be capable of accomplishing?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! How did you end up like this?

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: That's not the topic for now... Without food, the last four left of the Ninth Company could be gone at any moment.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: No other agendas?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Draw your sword) You can enjoy a sumptuous meal in prison, you know?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright, let's build a bit of trust here first, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Give up on communication) I don't like your hat.

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: Please consider our request.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They're so weak. Just a few kicks and they're already down!

dialogues.speaker: Anton
dialogues.text: Stop! Please stop! Give us some food and we'll do anything as you wish!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmph... They're really desperate for food.

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: Lemme put it this way: Whatever doubts you may have, the only purpose we have here is to investigate the source of the calamity in The Chasm.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What calamity? Paimon's seen no sign of it in The Chasm.

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: The calamity that happened five hundred years ago is just a beginning. The war against the dark has never stopped, and we're standing on one of the very battlefields of it.

response.speaker: Danila
response.text: *sigh* Our Serzhant CO is so hungry that he's started to talk some crazy stuff...

response.speaker: Temur
response.text: He always likes to exaggerate, but this is the first time he's talked nonsense.

response.speaker: Radomir
response.text: Forget it... Antoha does have a point, which is you people of Liyue are no enemy to us.

response.speaker: Anton
response.text: At least no enemy to us... As for our comrades who went missing, I'm not so sure how they might perceive you.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: OK... I'll help you, but just this once.
